君も笑いを堪えていたし、すぐに気づいたよ。
text.official_en:
Yes—my portions of food kept increasing, while you
giggled to the side. I noticed.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何にも憚らず自分のままあなたと食事ができる。
僕にはとても幸福なことです。
text.official_en:
It's nice, enjoying a meal as myself. Not having to
keep my guard up.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
俺にとってもありがたいことだ。
平和になった後も共に料理を楽しもう。
text.official_en:
I like it too. Someday, we'll share a meal like this to
celebrate the end of the war.
text.real_en: I'm grateful for it, too. Let's enjoy a meal together even after the war ends.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
御身を独り占めするのは心苦しいですが
食事を共にでき、嬉しい限りです！
text.official_en:
I'm sorry to steal you away from your duties, but I
relish any chance to share a meal together.
text.real_en: I feel bad monopolizing your time, but I'm truly happy to share this meal with you!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なるほど、良い顔で笑うものだ。
これは乙女の心が揺さぶられるのも道理よの。
text.official_en:
I see now the winning smile which must set the
maidens' hearts aflutter.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もう子供じゃないんだから、
食事にまで口を挟まないでよ！
text.official_en:
Would you please not butt in while I'm eating?
Y'know, I'm not a kid anymore.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
子供じゃないなら嫌いな物でも
ちゃんと食べるようになりな！
text.official_en: Well, you still eat like one! Don't be so picky, Mu.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ライサンダー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
君と話がしたいと思っていたところだ。
今日は存分に語らおうじゃないか。
text.official_en:
There are a number of things I felt we should
discuss over a meal. Where shall we begin?
text.real_en: I've been wanting to talk to you. Let's talk to our hearts' content today.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんか面倒そー……
ま、食事ついででいいなら付き合ったげるー。
text.official_en:
What did I let myself in for? Oh, well. At least I get
food out of it.
text.real_en: Sounds like a hassle... Well, I suppose I'll join you if we're eating anyway.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ルルディヤー
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
バッカニアさん、食事作法も完璧ですね……
一緒に食べていて気持ちがいいです！
text.official_en:
Always a pleasure, Buccar! I gotta say, your table
manners are even better than mine!
text.real_en: Buccaneer-san, your table manners are perfect... It's a pleasure to eat with you!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
当然だ。配下の者の礼儀作法が粗末であれば、
主君が嗤われることになるからな。
text.official_en:
Of course. A retainer with crude manners can only
embarrass his liege.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私、庶民のような食べ方の特訓をしているんですよ。
いつかお見せしますね。
text.official_en:
I've been learning to eat more like the commonfolk.
I'll show you sometime.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
確かに初めて会った時は隠すよう言ったけど……
もう庶民のふりはしなくてもいいんじゃない？
text.official_en:
I know you were in hiding back when we met, but...
Why are you pretending to be a commoner now?
text.real_en: I did tell you to hide it when we first met, but... Do you really need to pretend to be a commoner anymore?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_レダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……そうじっくりあたしを見てないで
あなたも早く食べなさい。
text.official_en:
What are you staring for? Come on, hurry up and eat
your food.
text.real_en: Stop staring at me like that and eat your food already.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
えへへ……レダさんの食べ方、
綺麗だからつい見とれちゃった。
text.official_en: Ehe... I'm just admiring how you eat! It's so elegant.
text.real_en: Hehe... Leda-san, you eat so gracefully, I couldn't help admiring you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いいかいロレッタ。食べ方にも品位は表れる。
匙はこのように使って、ゆっくりと……
text.official_en:
Loretta, the purpose of a dining utensil is to
introduce grace to the act of eating.
text.real_en: Listen, Loretta. Manners show in how you eat, too. Hold your spoon like this, and eat slowly...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ロレッタ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うげー……飯の時くらい、
説教なしで食わせてくれねえかな……
text.official_en: Seteth... Come on. Let's just eat.
text.real_en: Ugh... Can't you at least let me eat without a lecture...?
